## Amazon Web Services

How do I operate AWS?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [AWS Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/) | Amazon Web Services | Entry point to AWS's guides and references by service category, with tutorials, decision guides, and prescriptive guidance. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [AWS Architecture Center](https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/) | Amazon Web Services | AWS's reference architectures, decision guides, and best practices for designing workloads on its cloud. | Reference | Free |
| [AWS Well-Architected](https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/well-architected/) | Amazon Web Services | AWS's framework for reviewing a workload against six pillars: operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability. | Standard | Free |
| [AWS Pricing Calculator](https://calculator.aws/) | Amazon Web Services | Build a cost estimate for a planned AWS architecture; the public calculator works without signing in. | Online service | Free |
| [AWS Health Dashboard](https://health.aws.amazon.com/health/status) | Amazon Web Services | Status of AWS services now and in the past, on tabs for open and recent issues and for service history. | Status page | Free |
| [What's New with AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/new/) | Amazon Web Services | AWS's running list of launch and feature announcements. | Reference | Free |
| [AWS CLI Command Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/) | Amazon Web Services | Reference for version 2 of the aws command: synopsis, global options, and the services it can manage. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/) | Amazon Web Services | Guides and patterns from AWS and its partners for migrating to and modernizing on AWS, including a security reference architecture. | Reference | Free |
| [AWS re:Post](https://repost.aws/) | Amazon Web Services | AWS's question-and-answer community, with expert-reviewed answers and official AWS knowledge articles, organized by topic. | Community | Free |
| [AWS General Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/Welcome.html) | Amazon Web Services | Where AWS documents service endpoints and quotas, its IP address ranges, security credentials, and glossary. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/) | Amazon Web Services | AWS's documentation set for EKS: the user guide, best practices guide, API and CLI references, and the eksctl tool. | Vendor documentation | Free |
